mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 0.5pp rise trigger activates but SPX 5-day returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year for 3 consecutive months, it signals an overheating economy that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 3% trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month for two consecutive periods, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drag on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 months but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 300,000 jobs in a single month, it signals a surge in labor demand that will boost consumer spending and support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS 300k trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) rises above 55 for three consecutive months, it signals a strengthening industrial sector that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by an expanding labor market (UNRATE falling).
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 for 3 months but SPX 60-day returns are negative > 40% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year for 6 consecutive months, it signals a dangerous mix of ultra-easy monetary policy and rising inflation that will eventually lead to a sharp market correction, with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY for 6 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.
